capture: Actual source browser with disposable example data; window-only screenshot
history_storage: Adjacent atlas.json.history.sqlite3 with compressed full snapshots and content hashes
recording: Initial observed baseline and valid different previous backup; then changed successful content saves with UTC times, stable IDs, sequence order, parent links, summaries and application/data-format versions
unknown_dates: Existing concept creation dates and recovered backup save dates are explicitly unknown
crash_recovery: Durable hidden pending revision; authoritative JSON content confirms or discards an interrupted save
failed_save: History preparation failure blocks replacement; failed JSON saves do not become completed revisions; interrupted confirmation reports the successful JSON save with a recovery warning
preview: Separate read-only VTK scene; no writes or changes to the active document, backup, camera or heat range
restore: New revision appended with intervening history retained
archive: Atomic ZIP export of current JSON, individually importable revision JSON files and lineage/timestamp/change metadata
limitations: Automatic playback and timeline scrubbing are not implemented
Whole-history archive import is not implemented
Use one application window per atlas
No physical clean Windows or additional Linux distributions tested
palette: Saturated blue, cyan, yellow, orange and red; no white or green; direct cyan-to-yellow boundary
